summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for planned gastrostomy tube placement to transition from parenteral to enteral nutrition due to chronic nausea, poor oral intake, and malnutrition following bariatric surgery. The procedure was performed under fluoroscopic guidance and completed without complications. Post-procedure, she tolerated clear liquids and was advanced to goal tube feeds within 24 hours. Her nausea improved, and she also tolerated a regular diet. The PICC line was removed, and she remained afebrile with stable vital signs. She was discharged home on enteral nutrition with a Zevex Infinity Pump, oral pantoprazole, and home medications, including nortriptyline for cyclic vomiting syndrome. Discharge instructions included tube site care, activity restrictions, and close symptom monitoring.
